record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: Prove the Ivrii conjecture for three-periodic trajectories of multidimensional outer symplectic billiards with respect to a strictly convex closed hypersurface: the set of periodic orbits should have measure zero.

evidence.quote: Prove it for 3-periodic multidimensional outer symplectic billiards.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ (with $n \geq 1$) be a smooth, strictly convex, closed hypersurface bounding a convex domain in the standard symplectic vector space $(\mathbb{R}^{2n}, \omega)$. The outer symplectic billiard map is defined on points $x \in \mathbb{R}^{2n} \setminus \overline{\mathrm{int}\, M}$ as follows: from $x$ one draws the (generically unique) characteristic chord of $M$ — a chord of $M$ tangent to the characteristic foliation of $M$ (the foliation by integral curves of $\ker(\omega|_{TM})$) — whose midpoint, together with $x$, satisfies the appropriate outer-billiard reflection rule; the image $T(x)$ is the point obtained by reflecting $x$ through that midpoint (equivalently, $x$ and $T(x)$ are symmetric with respect to a point of $M$ along a characteristic direction). 

A point $x$ is called $3$-periodic if $T^3(x) = x$ but $T(x) \neq x$. Let $\mathrm{Per}_3(T) \subset \mathbb{R}^{2n} \setminus \overline{\mathrm{int}\, M}$ denote the set of all $3$-periodic points.

Prove the Ivrii-type conjecture in this setting: for every such $M$, the set $\mathrm{Per}_3(T)$ has Lebesgue measure zero in $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Sharipova, 2024, "Ivrii's conjecture for some cases in outer and symplectic billiards") provides new geometric proofs of the 3- and 4-periodic cases for planar outer and symplectic billiards and generalizes the result to higher dimensions for symplectic billiards. However, the multidimensional outer symplectic billiards case for 3-periodic orbits does not appear to have been fully established in that work, so the problem appears partially solved at best.

status_evidence.title: Ivrii's conjecture for some cases in outer and symplectic billiards
status_evidence.snippet: We also give new simple geometric proofs for the 3 and 4-periodic cases for outer and symplectic billiards, and generalize for higher dimensions in case of symplectic billiards.
status_evidence.claim: Higher-dimensional generalization is given for symplectic billiards; outer symplectic billiards in higher dimensions are not explicitly covered for the 3-periodic case.

status_evidence.title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
status_evidence.snippet: Prove it for 3-periodic multidimensional outer symplectic billiards.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is listed as an open problem.
